name: GTA GU1 & GU2 / GNC iX Data Center
notes: GTA's current data-center page lists GU1 and GU2 as Tier 3-designed carrier-neutral data centers and cable landing stations with 2MW of power across 11,800 sq ft, landing JGA North, JGA South, and SEA-US. DataCenterMap and Submarine Networks identify the Piti/GNC iX facility as a purpose-built neutral CLS and data center.

name: GTA GU3 / Alupang Data Center
notes: GTA says GU3 will offer more than 32,000 sq ft and 4MW of power and be ready for equipment in Q3 2025. GTA's 2022 Business Wire groundbreaking release described the Alupang facility in Tamuning as a Tier III-standard data center and cable landing station with over 31,000 sq ft and 4MW; DCD later reported it would land the MYUS cable.

name: Pipefish Services Dededo/Tamuning Data Center
notes: Isla Public Media reported Guam Hybrid Land Use Commission approval of height variances for a proposed 50,000 sq ft data center near Tanguisson Beach Road on the Dededo/Tamuning border. DCD and Baxtel describe a roughly 10-acre, about $3 million Pipefish Services project; capacity and end use were not disclosed.

name: Government of Guam Green Tier IV Data Center / IXP
developer: Government of Guam Office of Infrastructure Policy and Development
notes: The Governor's Office said Guam's Five-Year Action Plan includes construction of a Tier 4 data center to reduce latency for real-time applications. DCD summarized the plan as a green, solar-powered Tier IV data center intended to act as a world-class IXP, with site selection criteria including elevation, ocean proximity, grid access, fiber proximity, and land sufficient for a 5-10MW solar farm and tech park campus; data-center IT capacity was not disclosed.

name: University of Guam Office of Information Technology Data Center
developer: Government of Guam / University of Guam
notes: DCD and Baxtel reported a planned two-story, 15,000 sq ft data center/Office of Information Technology building on the University of Guam campus with an estimated $15 million investment, replacing or supplementing the older campus Computer Center. Inflect lists University of Guam Mangilao among Guam data center locations.

name: Guam Exchange Harmon 1 Data Center
notes: Guam Exchange's website describes an open-access, carrier-neutral data center with colocation, interconnection, and IXP services at 122 West Harmon Industrial Park Road, Suite 103, Tamuning. SubTel Forum reported the Harmon Tier III-compliant data center campus was to be ready for service on August 15, 2024; Guam IX says peering is available at the Guam Exchange Datacenter.

name: DoCoMo Pacific Harmon Data Center
notes: DoCoMo Pacific's business site offers data center colocation with power, cooling, security, connectivity, and a 99.99% uptime SLA. DataCenterMap identifies the DoCoMo Harmon Data Center at 467 Harmon Loop Road in Guam and lists 1MW; Baxtel also tracks DoCoMo Guam as an operational market facility.

name: IT&E Guam Data Center
notes: Inflect lists an IT&E Guam data center at 122 Harmon Industrial Park Road, Tamuning, with 144kW total power capacity. Baxtel and Datacenters.com also list IT&E Guam as an operational Guam data center, but project-level public details are limited.

name: Tata Communications Piti Cable Landing Station / Data Center
notes: Submarine Networks identifies the Piti CLS on Guam's western shore as a Tata/VSNL cable landing station for TGN Pacific and related systems. Baxtel and Cloudscene classify Tata Piti CLS as a Guam data center/facility; public sources found do not disclose IT capacity.
